preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 200.
The number of special nodes K and the number of nodes N must be between 1 and 200,000.
The node a must be a valid node number between 1 and N.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= f[i] <= N for i in range(K))
preconditions.description: All special nodes f[i] must be valid node numbers between 1 and N.
All special nodes must be unique.
The number of edges must be exactly N - 1.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly 2 * N space-separated integers.

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(int(x), int) for x in stdout.split())
postconditions.description: All output integers must be valid integers.

postconditions.expression: any(int(x) == max_value for x in stdout.split()[::2])
postconditions.description: The output must contain the maximum value of d(a,u) - d(b,u) for each node b.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= int(x) <= N for x in stdout.split()[1::2])
postconditions.description: The output must contain valid special node numbers for each node b.
